title: docc log output
description: What docc log --format json prints: one object on one line. The commits of the first-parent chain of --rev that changed anything in the source folder, newest first, down to --since (not included). Merges count as their change against the first parent.

parents.description: First parent first; empty for a root commit.

body.description: The message after the subject, trailing newlines cut.

commentsOnly.description: Every file of the commit is commentsOnly.

files.description: Every file below the source folder the commit changed, in Git's order.

status.description: Added, modified, deleted, renamed (a copy is A, a type change M). A file moved into or out of the source folder is A or D.

path.description: Relative to src, as the path of a page of docc compile; for D the last path.

oldPath.description: R only: the path before the rename.

id.description: A JSON file (a document): its id, the file name without .json.

title.description: A document: its title in this version (for D its last one, for a broken version its last good one).

blocks.description: How many blocks of the page (the body and free fields; not the title, metadata, notes or $comments; empty ones not counted) were added, changed and removed, lined up as docc diff lines them up. A new document counts all its blocks as add, a deleted one as rm; 0 for a file that is not a document or not valid JSON.

commentsOnly.description: M of a JSON file whose only change is inside its top-level "$comments" (both versions parsed, $comments dropped, compared as JSON).

broken.description: This version is not a valid JSON object; blocks are 0 and the next good version counts against the last good one.

hidden.description: The document says "hidden": true (for D: its last version): readers do not see it.
